prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original finished ultra-wide photographic banner for a designer's portfolio, 3:1 landscape, ideally 1536 x 512 pixels. This image is the banner artwork only, NOT a whole webpage, NOT a contact sheet. Full bleed, no outer margin, no rounded outer frame, no watermarks. Exceptional art-directed editorial product photography with realistic device mockups, correct device geometry and faithful interface branding. All major text and product features must fit within the center 88% of the image. The actual project interface described below is the authority for device screens. Creative scene photography is illustrative, not a claim about a real location, product outcome or study. Compact default Aurelia Hospitality banner. A limestone Bali villa terrace, espresso teak roof, infinity pool and muted ocean under golden sunlight, a single upright black smartphone at right. Its screen reproduces the project's real visual identity: exact spaced white serif wordmark 'AURELIA', full-bleed limestone coastal villa hero, elegant white serif heading 'Come for Bali.' followed by italic 'Stay for the house.', cream check-in/check-out fields and dark forest-green #29483A 'Plan my stay' button. At left a modest ivory serif 'Aurelia' wordmark on the shaded stone. Warm stone, muted olive, teak and sea blue. Wide strip, strong central visual, readable as a small 450 x 110px banner; small scene and ONE device, NOT the full expanded composition.
